mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO vm_video_screen_config_channel (screen_config_id, device_code, channel_code, creator, create_time, delete_flag) values
(#{id},#{item.deviceCode},#{item.channelCode},#{creator},NOW(),0)
mapper.select: select t1.device_code,t1.channel_code,t1.screen_config_id,t2.device_name,t3.channel_name from vm_video_screen_config_channel t1 left join vm_device_info_t t2 on t1.device_code = t2.device_code left join vm_channel_info_t t3 on t1.channel_code = t3.channel_code where screen_config_id = #{id}
